env GIT_EDITOR=true

# Repo with a 2-commit 'feat' branch that conflicts at every step when rebased
# onto main (every commit rewrites f entirely).
exec git init
exec git checkout -b main
exec git config user.email tester@email.com
exec git config user.name Testeur

cp f-base f
exec git add f
exec git commit -m base

exec git checkout -b feat
cp f-a f
exec git commit -am f1
cp f-b f
exec git commit -am f2

exec git checkout main
cp f-x f
exec git commit -am mainx

# Build gitmux and go back to work dir.
cd $GITMUX_DIR
go build -o $WORK/gitmux .
cd $WORK

# Rebase pauses on step 1/2 with a conflict.
exec git checkout feat
! exec git rebase main
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
stdout '\[rebase\] feat 1/2 conflict 1\|C1'
stdout '\[rebase\] [0-9a-f]+'

# Metadata missing/changed: branch and progress become 'unknown', but the
# conflict evidence keeps the paused operation visible.
rm .git/rebase-merge/head-name
rm .git/rebase-merge/msgnum
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
stdout '\[rebase\] unknown unknown conflict 1'

# Restore metadata.
cp head-name .git/rebase-merge/head-name
cp msgnum .git/rebase-merge/msgnum

# Zero conflicts after resolving does NOT complete the rebase: staged changes
# are reported as the pause reason.
cp resolved f
exec git add f
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
stdout '\[rebase\] feat 1/2 staged'

# Continue: step advances to 2/2 with another conflict.
! exec git rebase --continue
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
stdout '\[rebase\] feat 2/2 conflict 1\|C1'

# Resolve and continue to completion: operation summary disappears and the
# original branch is back.
cp resolved f
exec git add f
exec git rebase --continue
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
! stdout '\[rebase\]'
stdout 'feat'

# Pause a new rebase (single conflicting commit) and abort: metadata must be
# cleared and the branch restored.
exec git branch base-main main
exec git checkout main
cp f-y f
exec git commit -am mainy
exec git checkout -b aborttest base-main
cp f-z f
exec git commit -am f3
! exec git rebase main
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
stdout '\[rebase\] aborttest 1/1 conflict 1\|C1'
exec git rebase --abort
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
! stdout '\[rebase\]'
stdout 'aborttest'

-- .gitignore --
.gitignore
.gopath
.tmp
gitmux
gitmux.yml
f-base
f-a
f-b
f-x
f-y
f-z
resolved
head-name
msgnum

-- f-base --
base
-- f-a --
aaa
-- f-b --
bbb
-- f-x --
main-x
-- f-y --
main-y
-- f-z --
feat-z
-- resolved --
resolved-content
-- head-name --
refs/heads/feat
-- msgnum --
1
-- gitmux.yml --
tmux:
    symbols:
        branch: ""
        conflict: "C"
    styles:
        clear: ""
        state: ""
        branch: ""
        divergence: ""
        conflict: ""
        staged: ""
        op: ""
    layout: [branch, "|", op, "|", flags]
